svg.title: Tools Jake uses
svg.desc: Languages: Luau, Java, Python, JavaScript. Python and data: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, Tkinter. Web: HTML, CSS, Vue.js, Node.js, XML, Postman, XSLT, DTD. Databases: SQL, MySQL, MongoDB. Tooling: Git, GitHub, Visual Studio Code. Beside the list, a small graphics card drawn in 3D with two spinning fans.
